```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats support doubling investments in community health centers and rural health clinics in underserved urban and rural areas.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support increased support for dental care, mental health care, and substance use services like medication-assisted treatment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support increased support for mobile health clinics.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will enact longer, multi-year funding cycles for critical health services so they can operate with greater certainty.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Community health centers are required by law to be located in medically underserved areas and required to serve all who seek care, regardless of their ability to pay.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will leverage innovative payment options through Medicare and Medicaid to help community health centers and rural health clinics keep their doors open.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will expand the National Health Service Corps and Teaching Health Center Graduate Medical Education Program to grow a diverse primary care workforce.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will address critical shortages of health care providers in medically underserved rural and urban areas, including primary care nurses, dental professionals, and mental health and substance use counselors.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will increase monitoring and enforcement to ensure that health care facilities are accessible to people with disabilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
